# eu-ai-act-checklist

EU AI Act checklist (2024/1689 as amended by 2026/1744): prohibited, high-risk, transparency and GPAI triggers mapped to obligations and dates. Python package `eu_ai_act_checklist`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
